title: Stars: from drifting points to a quiet screen
description: Actual design decisions paired with their data and implementation. A curated account of the work, not a verbatim session transcript.
footer: Figure provenance and software licenses: /stars-assets/credits.txt. The display illustrates constellation figures; it is not a live sky chart.

plans.title: Build the constellation behavior
plans.summary: Source the figures, preserve the wandering, then refine the lock and release.

steps.title: Separate the figure from the surrounding sky
steps.description: Transcribe explicit figure membership and catalog coordinates. Chart regions contain many background stars; they must not become part of the recognizable figure by accident.

steps.title: Borrow a display pose, preserve the live path
steps.description: Assign existing nearby dots to a rigid shape. The running particle state is not rewritten, so it remains available when the constellation releases.

artifact.title: Actual assignment and safety checks

steps.title: Make the visible figure and its name arrive together
steps.description: Hercules exposed a polish problem: catalog lines could finish appearing before the shared named lock. Keep explicit lines and contrast hidden during gathering. Reserve a 15–20 second readable hold after the lock sweep.

steps.title: Retract connections before returning to drift
steps.description: Each edge splits at its center and shortens into both endpoint stars. A cardinal sweep staggers the retraction; stars remain fixed until their lines clear.

artifact.title: Actual edge retraction

steps.title: Reject a cramped or misleading result
steps.description: The complete source figure and name must fit on the screen and avoid clock, reminders, surf and other figures. Five is a maximum, not a demand to fill the screen.

plans.title: Make it a browser screensaver
plans.summary: Give the visitor control, then remove the interface and keep the display honest.

steps.title: Start with the device, then allow a choice
steps.description: Normalize persisted settings, validate IANA zones, and keep optional panels independent. Reminder and constellation sliders keep their choices in local browser storage. Constellation target interval defaults to10 seconds, adjustable through60; gathering and safety still apply.

artifact.title: Actual settings model

steps.title: Schedule tips in the selected local time
steps.description: Use local wall-clock boundaries. Show a message for 30 seconds, then glitch it out. Never replay missed reminders after a backgrounded tab resumes.

artifact.title: Actual reminder schedule

steps.title: Distinguish a wave model from observed surf
steps.description: Request offshore wave height and period only after waves are enabled. Validate timestamps and numeric ranges; unavailable data must not look current.

artifact.title: Actual forecast validation

steps.title: Leave only the configured display
steps.description: After confirmation, remove the settings, fade controls after inactivity, support fullscreen, and pause work in background tabs. Reduced motion keeps the ambient scene still.

steps.title: Check the behavior, then publish
steps.description: The desktop constellation work passed 150 database, geometry, timing and overlay checks. The browser adaptation adds focused model and page tests plus the existing website build. Browser layout and interactions are checked separately.
